title: The Whispering Inkwell
narrative: Set upon a moss-covered pedestal sits an obsidian inkwell swirling with luminescent violet ink. The pages in your satchel flutter eagerly toward it.

phrases.hard: submerge your typewriter ribbon in the violet ink

choices.outcomeText: Your ribbon absorbs the volatile magic! A card in your deck is permanently revised, though the fumes singe your fingers.

phrases.hard: boldly drink from the swirling violet pedestal

choices.outcomeText: Pure typographic brilliance surges through your veins! You gain a Rare card and expand your maximum vitality.
choices.failText: The unstable violet ink curdles in your chest (-8 HP) and permanently stains your satchel with a Smudged Manuscript!

phrases.hard: carefully cork the inkwell to trade for coins

choices.outcomeText: You seal the vessel and trade it to a passing courier for a pouch of gold.

phrases.hard: step away from the strange pedestal unharmed

choices.outcomeText: You decide not to risk your fingers and continue climbing toward the tower.

title: The Silent Choir
narrative: You stumble upon a circle of statuesque figures. Their mouths are magically fused shut, yet they hold tattered sheet music, their eyes pleading for someone to read the notes aloud.

phrases.hard: carefully transcribe the forbidden melody onto parchment

choices.outcomeText: As your pen traces the notes, a phantom harmony fills the air, mending your wounds.

phrases.hard: wave your quill like a baton to awaken the choir

choices.outcomeText: The statues resonate with silent gratitude, bestowing an ancient relic and revising one of your drafts!
choices.failText: A discordant shockwave snaps your quill and rattles your ribs!

phrases.hard: snatch the ancient sheet music from their frozen hands

choices.outcomeText: You take the rare composition to sell later, though the figures weep silent tears of ink that burn your skin.

title: Pyre of Words
narrative: A group of the Evil Wizard's ink-golems are tossing precious bound books into a roaring green fire. The scent of burning knowledge fills the air.

phrases.hard: brave the emerald flames to rescue a tome

choices.outcomeText: You plunge your hand into the fire, retrieving a powerful manuscript and revising a card at the cost of severe burns.

phrases.hard: sprint behind the golems to loot their coin lockbox

choices.outcomeText: You deftly slip past the lumbering golems and escape with their entire confiscations chest!
choices.failText: A golem spots your shadow and hurls a glob of molten emerald wax across your back!

phrases.hard: hurl a heavy stone to distract the burning golems

choices.outcomeText: The golems lumber away, leaving behind a partially burned spellbook you manage to salvage.

phrases.hard: silently creep past the tragic burning library

choices.outcomeText: You avoid the flames and the guards, moving on unharmed.

title: The Synonym Smuggler
narrative: A cloaked figure pssts at you from a dark alley. They open their coat to reveal prohibited dictionaries, wax dice, and thesauruses dangling from the lining.

phrases.hard: trade your gold for an illegal antique dictionary

choices.outcomeText: You hand over your coins, receiving a heavy, leather-bound volume radiating archaic power.

phrases.hard: accept the smuggler high stakes lexicon dice wager

choices.outcomeText: Your dice spell out a winning triad! The smuggler groans and hands over a hefty purse and a rare scroll.
choices.failText: The weighted bone dice roll blank! The smuggler chuckles and relieves you of your coin.

phrases.hard: draw your weapon and demand the forbidden texts

choices.outcomeText: Startled by your bold stanza, the smuggler drops a relic and bolts into the fog!
choices.failText: The smuggler hurls a flash-ink bomb into your eyes and escapes while you cough!

title: The Last Gramophone
narrative: In an abandoned parlor, a rusted gramophone plays a scratched record. It is the last known recording of a human voice, and its melancholic tune is fading.

phrases.hard: delicately repair the rusted gears of the machine

choices.outcomeText: The voice rings out clear for a moment, filling you with renewed vigor and permanent resolve.

phrases.hard: wind the brass crank to amplify the forbidden song

choices.outcomeText: The amplified aria shatters the curse around your satchel, upgrading two aspects of your kit!
choices.failText: The overwound spring snaps violently, launching brass shrapnel across your arms!

phrases.hard: shatter the haunted record to end the sad song

choices.outcomeText: The shattered vinyl reveals a hidden compartment containing a forgotten relic, though a sharp shard nicks your hand.

title: The Wall of Defiance
narrative: You find a crumbling brick wall covered in glowing graffiti. Citizens have etched their forbidden thoughts and protests against the Wizard here.

phrases.hard: etch your own words of rebellion onto the wall

choices.outcomeText: Writing your truth bolsters your maximum spirit and purges a weak page from your deck, though the backlash stings.

phrases.hard: carefully study the glowing rebellious incantations

choices.outcomeText: You learn a new technique hidden within the overlapping scrawls.

phrases.hard: scrape the luminous gold leaf from the bricks

choices.outcomeText: You carefully flake off a small fortune in enchanted gold leaf!
choices.failText: The rebellious runes flare in anger, searing your knuckles!

title: Flock of Pages
narrative: A sudden gale sweeps through the canyon, carrying a flock of enchanted paper pages that flutter like trapped white birds.

phrases.hard: vault toward the cliff edge to snatch the golden manuscript

choices.outcomeText: Your fingers close around the gilded sheet! It binds itself into your deck as a Rare card alongside a shower of coins.
choices.failText: A gust buffets you against the canyon rock as the gilded sheet slips away!

phrases.hard: leap up to snatch the fluttering magical pages

choices.outcomeText: You catch a handful of pages. One contains a sharp new concept.

phrases.hard: stand still and watch the paper birds fly away

choices.outcomeText: One page lands gently on your shoulder, dissolving into healing warmth.

title: The Desperate Mime
narrative: A beggar in tattered clothes approaches you. Unable to speak, they perform frantic, elaborate mimes, pointing to their stomach and your gold.

phrases.hard: generously offer your gold to the starving mime

choices.outcomeText: The beggar bows deeply and hands you a strange, glowing trinket from their pocket in gratitude.

phrases.hard: split your travel rations with the silent performer

choices.outcomeText: Though you go slightly hungry, the mime teaches you how to trim wasted movements from your deck.

phrases.hard: coldly ignore the beggar and continue your journey

choices.outcomeText: You walk past. Your purse remains heavy.

title: The Ink-String Lute
narrative: Lying in the dirt is a beautiful lute. Its wooden body is intact, but the strings are made of liquid ink that drips slowly into the soil.

phrases.hard: carefully pluck the dripping ink strings of the lute

choices.outcomeText: A dissonant, sharp chord rings out, slicing your skin but sharpening your mind. You upgrade a card and purge clutter.

phrases.hard: attempt to perform a legendary forbidden ballad

choices.outcomeText: The ink-strings sing in resonant harmony, weaving a priceless relic and healing your spirit!
choices.failText: All six ink-strings snap at once, whipping across your forearms!

phrases.hard: dismantle the wooden instrument to sell for parts

choices.outcomeText: You break the instrument down. The rare rosewood fetches a tidy sum.

title: Cave of Echoes
narrative: You enter a cavern where spoken words were once stored. Now, it only echoes the scratching of pens and the rustle of turning pages.

phrases.hard: force a hoarse shout into the echoing cavern depths

choices.outcomeText: The cave violently rejects the sound, tearing at your life force, but spitting out an ancient relic.

phrases.hard: uncork a glass vial to capture a resonant echo

choices.outcomeText: You cork a shimmering syllable! It condenses into a Rare card and revitalizing warmth.
choices.failText: A screeching echo shatters the glass vial in your palm!

phrases.hard: silently trace a message into the thick cave dust

choices.outcomeText: The dust swirls and forms a pile of coins, rewarding your silent respect.

title: The Gagged Idol
narrative: A towering marble statue of a legendary opera singer stands in the courtyard, her mouth bound by a heavy iron gag fastened with a rusted padlock.

phrases.hard: strike the rusted padlock with all your might

choices.outcomeText: The lock breaks! A trapped aria bursts forth, bruising you slightly, but granting permanent fortitude and a revised card.

phrases.hard: delicately pick the rusted padlock with a steel nib

choices.outcomeText: Click! The gag falls away smoothly, revealing a jeweled throat-charm inside the marble!
choices.failText: Your steel nib snaps inside the mechanism and the iron chain whips back at your hand!

phrases.hard: kneel in silent reverence before the tragic statue

choices.outcomeText: A soothing aura washes over you, healing your wounds.

phrases.hard: chisel out the statue cursed weeping sapphire eyes

choices.outcomeText: You pry out the sparkling gemstones! A torrent of gold spills into your satchel (+130 Gold), but weeping ghostly screams curse your parchment with Haunted Vellum!

title: The Obsidian Fountain
narrative: A grand plaza features a fountain that once sprayed crystal water. Now, thick, dark ink burbles from the spout, staining the surrounding stones.

phrases.hard: cup your hands and drink the dark obsidian ink

choices.outcomeText: It tastes of bitter iron and lost words. You feel sickened, but your deck is purged of a weak card.

phrases.hard: plunge your arms deep into the ink basin for coins

choices.outcomeText: Your fingers brush against sunken offerings! You haul up a heavy pouch of gold and an upgraded technique.
choices.failText: Something foul snaps at your wrist! Virulent black slime bites into your skin (-7 HP) and infects your satchel with Ink Rot!

phrases.hard: douse your writing implements in the dark fountain

choices.outcomeText: The ink hones your tools. A card in your deck is upgraded.

title: The Hollow Tree
narrative: Inside the hollow trunk of a dead oak tree, you find a bundled stack of unsent love letters, preserved perfectly despite the decay around them.

phrases.hard: carefully untie the ribbon and read the letters

choices.outcomeText: The passionate prose warms your cold heart, restoring your vitality.

phrases.hard: use the precious letters to start a warm campfire

choices.outcomeText: The magical paper burns bright and long. You gain permanent vitality and purge a weak card from your deck.

phrases.hard: reach past the letters into the dark root hollow

choices.outcomeText: Beneath the letters lies a velvet box holding an heirloom relic!
choices.failText: A nest of ink-wasps stings your hand repeatedly as you pull back!

title: The Floating Edict
narrative: A massive, glowing parchment floats in the middle of the road, magically projecting the Wizard's latest decree: 'ALL HUMMING IS PUNISHABLE BY ERASURE.'

phrases.hard: boldly strike through the wizard floating decree

choices.outcomeText: You violently strike through the Wizard's decree! A hidden purse bursts forth (+100 Gold), but imperial inquisitors brand your hand with a Royal Censor Writ!

phrases.hard: cleverly edit the floating decree to bless yourself

choices.outcomeText: Masterful editing! The hacked decree showers you with a Rare card and revises your deck.
choices.failText: The security glyph detects your edit and zaps your fingers with arcane static!

phrases.hard: carefully analyze the glowing enchantment on the parchment

choices.outcomeText: You reverse-engineer the spell, gaining a new card for your deck.

title: The Glowing Jar
narrative: Resting on an abandoned merchant's cart is a glass jar containing a pulsating, golden energy that looks strikingly like a pair of vocal cords.

phrases.hard: shatter the glass and inhale the golden energy

choices.outcomeText: A fleeting moment of song fills your mind! Your maximum health increases significantly and your wounds mend.

phrases.hard: touch your quill tip to the resonant golden jar

choices.outcomeText: Golden resonance flows into your satchel, producing a Rare card and revising an existing page!
choices.failText: The jar cracks with a sonic boom that knocks you backward!

phrases.hard: carefully place the valuable jar into your satchel

choices.outcomeText: You don't dare open it, but a rebel broker pays handsomely for it.

title: The Clockwork Typesetter
narrative: A towering brass linotype machine sits steaming beside the trail. Its molten lead pot bubbles softly, waiting for an operator courageous enough to key a line.

phrases.hard: hammer a lightning fast sequence across the brass keys

choices.outcomeText: Clack-shunk! The machine casts a gleaming Rare card slug and upgrades a draft in your satchel!
choices.failText: A jammed matrix sprays droplets of scalding lead across your wrists!

phrases.hard: feed an unwanted draft into the furnace for gold

choices.outcomeText: The furnace consumes your flawed page and mints fresh gold coins from the ash.

phrases.hard: warm your bruised fingers beside the brass boiler

choices.outcomeText: The steady warmth of the linotype boiler eases your aches.

title: The Spectral Editor
narrative: A translucent scholar wearing half-moon spectacles materializes before you, brandishing a glowing red pen. She gestures impatiently at your deck.

phrases.hard: hand over your entire manuscript for ruthless editing

choices.outcomeText: She nods approvingly! She trims a weak draft, polishes another, and gifts you her spare spectacle charm.
choices.failText: Incensed by a split infinitive, she slashes red marks across your knuckles—though she still deletes a bad card!

phrases.hard: offer forty gold coins for a formal style lesson

choices.outcomeText: For a modest fee, she elevates one of your cards and teaches you a Rare composition.

phrases.hard: tip your hat respectfully and decline the critique

choices.outcomeText: Charmed by your manners, she tosses you a small pouch of ink-tokens.

title: The Origami Chasm
narrative: A deep gorge blocks the path. Spanning the abyss is a bridge folded entirely from giant sheets of parchment that sway in the mountain wind.

phrases.hard: dash full speed across the swaying origami bridge

choices.outcomeText: Your light footsteps carry you across! Halfway over, you snatch a gilded satchel caught in the folds.
choices.failText: A wet crease tears beneath your boot! You scramble up the ledge with scraped shins.

phrases.hard: bind the paper bridge with spare wax and ink

choices.outcomeText: You spend 20 gold worth of sealing wax to cross safely, discovering a revised technique etched on the handrail.

phrases.hard: scale the exhausting cliff path around the gorge

choices.outcomeText: The detour bruises your knees, but builds lasting stamina.

title: The Underground Press
narrative: Hidden beneath a trapdoor, you discover an abandoned rebel printing cellar. Plates of illicit poetry are still locked into the iron rollers.

phrases.hard: heave the iron lever to print rebel broadsheets

choices.outcomeText: The physical strain leaves you winded, but rebel couriers pay generously for the fresh broadsheets and leave a Rare draft!

phrases.hard: experimentally recombine the leaden printing plates

choices.outcomeText: Eureka! Your experimental layout prints a masterwork Relic and upgrades a card!
choices.failText: The iron roller pinches your fingers and smudges a card in ink!

phrases.hard: catch your breath atop the warm bales of vellum

choices.outcomeText: You rest undisturbed in the quiet cellar, recovering your strength.

title: Shrine of the Crimson Seal
narrative: Candles of scarlet sealing wax drip onto a stone altar. Three brass signet rings rest in shallow bowls, each engraved with a different vow.

phrases.hard: stamp the burning crimson signet onto your wrist

choices.outcomeText: Hot wax sears your skin, but the signet fuses into a permanent Relic and purges your weakest page!

phrases.hard: test your luck with the shimmering golden signet

choices.outcomeText: The altar drawer slides open, overflowing with gold coins and a revised card!
choices.failText: A hidden needle pricks your thumb and drains a trickle of coin from your purse!

phrases.hard: touch the soothing emerald signet to your brow

choices.outcomeText: Warmth radiates from the wax, mending your wounds and fortifying your max health.

title: The Censored Cartographer
narrative: A blindfolded royal mapmaker sits atop a milestone, his compass needles carved from fountain pen nibs. His sprawling parchment maps have every landmark, river, and road blacked out with thick censor ink bars.

phrases.hard: carefully scrape censor ink from the parchment

choices.outcomeText: As you scrape away the thick black ink, a luminous secret trail reveals itself across the map, opening a hidden passage to the next floor!

phrases.hard: purchase the cartographer enchanted brass astrolabe

choices.outcomeText: You purchase the cartographer's finely tuned brass astrolabe, adding an ancient relic to your collection.

phrases.hard: boldly name the forgotten capital beneath the ink

choices.outcomeText: Your linguistic deduction strikes gold! You discover a rare manuscript and expand your stamina.
choices.failText: A censor ward flares from the page, searing your fingertips!

title: The Vowel Tax Collector
narrative: A stern magistrate bearing the Evil Wizard's imperial crest blocks the road, flanked by snarling ink hounds. He unfurls an edict: 'BY ORDER OF THE WIZARD: A TAX OF 60 GOLD IS LEVIED ON ALL COMMERCE OF VOWELS. COMPLY OR FACE ERASURE.'

phrases.hard: hand over sixty gold to pay the wizard vowel tax

choices.outcomeText: You hand over sixty gold. The collector sneers and stamps an unplayable, bureaucratic tax assessment into your satchel that clutters your hand.

phrases.hard: draw your quill and defy the wizard vowel tax

choices.outcomeText: 'Tax evasion is high treason against the Wizard!' the collector bellows, commanding his hounds to tear you apart!

title: The Mirror-Script Wall
narrative: A towering wall of polished obsidian rises before you, inscribed with glowing silver runes that run backwards. As you approach, the pages in your deck shimmer with an inverted reflection.

phrases.hard: quietly study the backwards silver runes on the wall

choices.outcomeText: Meditating on the backwards silver runes soothes your mind and expands your life force.

phrases.hard: press a card against the mirror wall to invert its magic

choices.outcomeText: The obsidian wall flashes with inverted light! Choose a card from your deck to invert its essence.

phrases.hard: align a card with the mirror silver runes to revise it

choices.outcomeText: Silver light traces the seams of your chosen draft, elevating it to its revised form.

title: The Gilded Palimpsest
narrative: A heavy calfskin codex rests on a brass lectern. Over centuries, scribes repeatedly scraped away old layers of text to write new ones: a monastic prayer, an alchemical recipe, and an ancient warlord's battle hymn.

phrases.hard: transcribe the ancient prayer of preservation

choices.outcomeText: The ancient prayer soothes your spirit and restores your resolve (+18 HP, Upgraded a card).

phrases.hard: scrape away modern layers to uncover ancient battle runes

choices.outcomeText: Razor-sharp vellum edges bite your fingertips as martial fury fills your drafts (-8 HP, Gained Rare Card).

phrases.hard: carefully harvest the alchemical gold leaf script

choices.outcomeText: Pure typographic bullion! You harvest lustrous alchemical gold and a preserved relic (+110 Gold, Gained Relic)!
choices.failText: Toxic arsenic and cinnabar pigments scorch your hands and lungs as the brittle foil disintegrates (-12 HP).

title: The Iron Bookbinder's Vise
narrative: An abandoned artisan's shop dominated by a cast-iron screw press. Heavy wooden boards and steel clamps lie ready to compress sprawling folios into tight, durable volumes.

phrases.hard: crank the iron wheel to bind your loose pages tight

choices.outcomeText: Strenuous cranking trims the ragged excess and reinforces your finest volume (-7 HP, Removed a Card, Upgraded a Card).

phrases.hard: strip the antique leather bindings to sell for coin

choices.outcomeText: You salvage pristine gilded calfskin covers to barter with traveling merchants (+65 Gold).

phrases.hard: rest comfortably among the fragrant bookbinding scraps

choices.outcomeText: You curl up in the fragrant leather shavings and rest undisturbed (+15 HP).

title: The Weeping Apostrophe
narrative: A colossal, moss-covered monolith shaped like a curved punctuation mark looms at a crossroads. Legend says it was carved to commemorate all omitted words and forgotten contractions.

phrases.hard: place an unwanted draft upon the weeping stone altar

choices.outcomeText: The weeping stone drinks the ink from your unwanted page, dissolving it into peaceful mist (+10 HP, Removed a Card).

phrases.hard: chisel decorative stone punctuation for market trade

choices.outcomeText: You pry loose flecks of glistening carved stone to sell at the nearest settlement (+55 Gold).

phrases.hard: whisper a plea into the hollow curve of the apostrophe

choices.outcomeText: The monolith resonates with primordial eloquence! Inscribed a random positive power onto your draft.
choices.failText: The crushing weight of collective sorrow fractures the stone, inscribing a random negative flaw onto your draft.

title: The Carrier Pigeon Loft
narrative: In the rafters of a crumbling watchtower, dozens of brass-clockwork pigeons preen their gears. Small cylinders containing secret rebel dispatches are strapped to their talons.

phrases.hard: intercept a courier cylinder carrying royal military orders

choices.outcomeText: You trade feed and coin for the courier cylinder, retrieving a rare military folio (-20 Gold, Gained Rare Card).

phrases.hard: replace the broken clockwork spring of an injured bird

choices.outcomeText: You mend the delicate clockwork spring. In gratitude, the mechanical bird drops an ancient brass relic into your hand before taking flight (-5 HP, Gained Relic).

phrases.hard: release a pigeon with an urgent plea to the resistance cell

choices.outcomeText: The mechanical pigeon returns bearing a pouch of rebel funds and a fresh combat draft (+80 Gold, Gained Card)!
choices.failText: The pigeon trips an Imperial alarm flare that scorches the loft and knocks your purse of gold into the canyon ravine (-11 HP, -35 Gold)!

title: The Blindfolded Scrivener
narrative: A monk sits in silence by a guttering candle, a thick cloth tied over his eyes so he cannot be swayed by the Wizard's hypnotic glyphs. His fingers trace raised paper with breathtaking precision.

phrases.hard: commission a tactile warding seal upon your satchel

choices.outcomeText: The monk impresses a hardened wax seal onto your satchel, granting a treasured warding relic (-45 Gold, Gained Relic).

phrases.hard: guide his calloused fingers across your favorite draft

choices.outcomeText: Guiding his nib across your parchment refines your drafts and produces a fresh manuscript (Upgraded a Card, +1 Card).

phrases.hard: press your ear close as he speaks forbidden future verses

choices.outcomeText: Prophetic whispers expand your mind, revealing an ancient rare folio (+6 Max HP, Gained Rare Card)!
choices.failText: The psychic reverberation of his forbidden future vision ruptures your blood vessels (-12 HP).

title: The Suffix Bazaar
narrative: Under a tattered awning, an outcast etymologist sells bubbling glass tubes labeled with grammatical affixes: '-tion', '-ing', '-able', and '-ment', glowing with structural magic.

phrases.hard: infuse your drafts with vibrant active grammatical endings

choices.outcomeText: The chemical grafting burns your fingers, but energizes your ink and produces valuable scrap trade (-6 HP, Upgraded a Card, +40 Gold).

phrases.hard: spend hard coin on an ancient pre-Imperial prefix talisman

choices.outcomeText: You purchase a rare pre-Imperial affix vial that stabilizes your journey (-50 Gold, Gained Relic).

phrases.hard: sift through discarded syllables and bruised vowels

choices.outcomeText: You sift through bruised syllables and discarded punctuation, rescuing a usable draft (+1 Card).

title: The Library of Dust
narrative: A cathedral-like reading hall where basilisk breath once washed through the arches. Both the open scrolls and the scholars studying them have been turned into solid limestone.

phrases.hard: carefully chisel an unbroken limestone scroll from a desk

choices.outcomeText: Exhausting hammer work chips away stone to reveal an intact enchanted relic embedded in the core (-8 HP, Gained Relic).

phrases.hard: sit quietly amidst the petrified scholars in peaceful study

choices.outcomeText: The serene stillness washes away fatigue, cleansing your spirit and bolstering your resolve (+14 HP, +4 Max HP).

phrases.hard: hammer open the petrified purse of an imperial chancellor

choices.outcomeText: The limestone sack cracks open, showering gold coins and an ancient preserved draft (+95 Gold, +1 Card)!
choices.failText: The brittle statue collapses, crushing you under heavy stone debris (-13 HP).

title: The Thesaurus Wyrm
narrative: Tangled in barbed hunting snares is a snakelike construct woven entirely from interlocking leather dictionary spines. When it breathes, shifting synonyms ripple down its articulated scales.

phrases.hard: inhale the shimmering cloud of shifting synonyms

choices.outcomeText: The lexical vapors scorch your throat but expand your linguistic insight (-7 HP, Gained Rare Card, Upgraded a Card).

phrases.hard: use your quill knife to gently untangle the wyrm leather coils

choices.outcomeText: You free the thrashing beast. In gratitude, it sheds a hardened dictionary spine scale (-4 HP, Gained Relic).

phrases.hard: recite rhyming stanzas to calm the thrashing lexical serpent

choices.outcomeText: The calmed wyrm curls into your satchel as an ally, granting the 'Call Wyrm' once-per-combat summon card (+1 Summon Card)!
choices.failText: The enraged wyrm snaps its iron snares and lunges to attack! (Battle Initiated — No Card Rewards Upon Victory)

title: The Sunken Scriptorium
narrative: A flooded monastery cellar where waist-deep teal water laps against stone pillars. Waterproof wax-sealed manuscript cases float among water lilies and drifting parchment.

phrases.hard: use a reed pole to retrieve floating waterproof scroll cases

choices.outcomeText: Calm salvaging yields crisp, undamaged prose from a buoyant wax tube (+12 HP, +1 Card).

phrases.hard: scrape precious waterproof seal wax to trade to couriers

choices.outcomeText: You collect blocks of rare waterproof wax to sell to traveling messengers (+60 Gold).

phrases.hard: plunge into the icy deep water to reach the iron vault

choices.outcomeText: You breach the submerged vault, bringing up an ancient sealed reliquary and rare folio (Gained Relic, Gained Rare Card)!
choices.failText: Swirling subterranean currents drag you under and rip your satchel open, washing 2 cards away into the deep (-5 HP, Lost 2 Cards).

title: The Ink Bleach Vat
narrative: A bubbling iron vat of milky, pungent lye solution tended by underground rebels. It is used to dissolve Imperial tracking ink and erase dangerous names from confiscated identity papers.

phrases.hard: submerge an unwanted card to dissolve its ink completely

choices.outcomeText: Caustic fumes sting your lungs, but the unwanted page is thoroughly purged from your deck (-5 HP, Removed a Card).

phrases.hard: bleach away marginal flaws and write fresh prose

choices.outcomeText: You rinse away errant ink and inscribe improved verses onto pristine parchment (Upgraded a Card).

title: The Tree of Confession
narrative: Deep in an overgrown clearing stands a colossal weeping oak tree with an antique carved confessional booth embedded directly into its hollow trunk. As you approach, the autumn leaves and creaking branches rustle with a quiet voice: 'Confess the word that weighs heaviest upon your soul.'

phrases.hard: speak the shameful secret that has burdened your conscience

choices.outcomeText: Unburdening your darkest secret purges an unwanted draft and fortifies your spirit (+4 Max HP, Removed a Card).

phrases.hard: press your ear to the wooden lattice to hear prior confessions

choices.outcomeText: Ancient whispering memories echo through the wood, teaching you refined writing mastery (Upgraded a Card)!
choices.failText: Writhing root tendrils suddenly shoot from the trunk, snatching a random draft from your satchel and dragging it into the bark! (Tree Stole a Card)

phrases.hard: reach into the deep root cavity to grab the tithe coffer

choices.outcomeText: You pull a heavy iron coffer from beneath the roots, bursting with forgotten pilgrim coins (+150 Gold)!
choices.failText: Thorny wooden boughs lash across your arms as you reach into the cavity (-11 HP).

title: The Vowel Black Market
narrative: A rogue goblin smuggler sitting behind a velvet counter offers to buy or sell the very alphabet you speak.

phrases.hard: sign away imperial rights to the letter u

choices.outcomeText: You sign the illicit vowel contract! Gold and an ancient talisman fill your pockets (+150 Gold, +1 Relic). The vowel U is silenced — whenever you play a card with no U, gain +2 Ward!

phrases.hard: spend coin on an enchanted vowel charm

choices.outcomeText: You purchase the master vowel seal. A rare card joins your satchel and your starter techniques are honed.

phrases.hard: blow a silver whistle to alert the royal bailiffs

choices.outcomeText: The smuggler flees in panic, dropping a pouch of coins on the cobblestones!

title: The Living Footnote
narrative: Scurrying across a ledger is a tiny animated ink-homunculus shaped like an asterisk (*). When it notices you, it hops onto your satchel, chattering in footnotes.

phrases.hard: attach the living asterisk to an existing manuscript

choices.outcomeText: The living footnote bonds to your manuscript! Choose a card in your deck: its energy cost is permanently reduced by 1 (minimum 0).

phrases.hard: carefully observe the erratic hops of the punctuation beast

choices.outcomeText: Studying the creature's lexical physiology invigorates your mind and body (+4 Max HP, Heal +8 HP).

phrases.hard: slam a glass vial over the skittering asterisk

choices.outcomeText: You capture the buzzing asterisk in a glass phial. It condenses into a wondrous Relic!
choices.failText: The footnote explodes in caustic punctuation sparks, singeing your fingers!

title: The Anagram Crucible
narrative: A molten forge where lead movable-type letters are melted in bubbling iron crucibles and recast into hybrid fonts.

phrases.hard: cast two unwanted drafts into the molten font crucible

choices.outcomeText: The molten letters melt and recombine! Choose two cards in your deck to fuse into a single hybrid Anagram card.

phrases.hard: douse the white hot font blocks with cooling ink

choices.outcomeText: You douse the molten forge with enchanted cooling ink. The billowing steam tempers two cards in your satchel!

phrases.hard: dig through discarded lead font shavings

choices.outcomeText: You scoop up valuable discarded lead typeface nuggets and pocket the coins.

title: The Astrolabe of Leylines
narrative: An ancient brass map table mounted on gimbals. By turning its dials, the ink routes painted on the floor shift and rearrange.

phrases.hard: align the celestial lenses to pacify dangerous routes

choices.outcomeText: Celestial lenses click into place. All ordinary combat encounters on the next floor are transmuted into Mystery encounters!

phrases.hard: overcharge the leyline dials to summon formidable adversaries

choices.outcomeText: The leylines glow with fierce crimson lightning. Secret paths are revealed across the map!

phrases.hard: unlock the hidden cartographer channels across the floor

choices.outcomeText: Hidden ink channels illuminate across the parchment map!

title: The Echo Cavern
narrative: A crystal cave where sound bounces indefinitely in rhythmic waves: 'H-h-hello... l-l-listen... e-e-echo...'

phrases.hard: recite a draft into the cavern to crystallize its echo

choices.outcomeText: Your voice crystallizes against the acoustic stalactites! A card is duplicated and upgraded in your deck.

phrases.hard: sing a pure sustained tone to vibrate acoustic crystals

choices.outcomeText: Harmonic resonance cleanses your mind and satchel (+10 HP, purge a card).

phrases.hard: chisel resonant acoustic crystals from cavern ceiling

choices.outcomeText: You chisel free a pristine acoustic geode holding an ancient Relic and glittering gold!
choices.failText: A resonant shockwave shatters overhead crystal stalactites, showering you in razor shards!

title: The Blacklist Bounty Hunter
narrative: A taciturn mercenary wrapped in torn parchment bandages sharpens a steel nib dagger beside a bulletin board of Wanted posters.

phrases.hard: sign your name to a high priority imperial bounty contract

choices.outcomeText: You take the Bounty Contract! Elite enemies take +30% damage and award +160 Gold upon defeat.

phrases.hard: hire the bounty hunter to secure your next battle

choices.outcomeText: You pay the mercenary fee. He agrees to aid your expedition, sharing valuable combat training (+8 HP, Upgrade a Card)!

phrases.hard: draw your nib and attack the rogue bounty hunter

choices.outcomeText: The hunter snarls and draws dual steel nib blades!

title: The Origami Master's Workshop
narrative: A quiet artisan with wooden folding bones folds intricate multidimensional animals out of heavy parchment sheets.

phrases.hard: buy a delicate folded crane talisman for good fortune

choices.outcomeText: The master gifts you a wondrous Origami Crane! Gain 6 Ward at the start of every combat.

phrases.hard: study structural strength of interlocking paper creases

choices.outcomeText: You master geometric folding armor (+5 Max HP, Heal +8 HP).

phrases.hard: fold discarded parchment scrap into a sharp origami dart

choices.outcomeText: You fold a discarded parchment scrap into a sharp technique and add it to your deck.

title: The Red Ink Audit Bureau
narrative: A gaunt bureaucrat with crimson spectacles sits behind an iron desk stacked with confiscated ledgers, holding a glowing red correction pen.

phrases.hard: slip a heavy pouch of bribe coin to receive an official exemption stamp

choices.outcomeText: The bureaucrat pockets your coin and stamps your satchel with the Auditor's Seal! You are permanently immune to curse cards.

phrases.hard: submit your deck to regulatory incineration

choices.outcomeText: The auditor ruthlessly strikes through two cluttered drafts in your satchel (-40 Gold, remove 2 cards).

phrases.hard: overturn the imperial audit desk and engage the bailiffs

choices.outcomeText: 'Insolent vagrant! Bailiffs, seize this debtor!' Guards rush in!

title: The Clockwork Metronome
narrative: A towering brass metronome ticks inside an abandoned musical conservatory. Its ticking synchronizes with your heartbeat.

phrases.hard: calibrate your satchel drafts to the hypnotic ticking tempo

choices.outcomeText: You synchronize your rhythm to the escapement wheel! You obtain the Clockwork Metronome: odd turns deal +4 attack damage; even turns grant +5 skill ward!

phrases.hard: disassemble the metronome balance wheel with your wrench

choices.outcomeText: Strenuous mechanical salvaging hurts your hands (-7 HP), but yields +85 Gold and refines a card!

phrases.hard: rest your weary mind to the steady hypnotic ticking

choices.outcomeText: The hypnotic meter lulls you into deep restoration. You heal +16 HP.

title: The Two Sentry Sphinxes
narrative:
Two towering marble statues with burning sapphire and amber eyes stand before two archways: the Arch of Silver Mist and the Arch of Gilded Light. One sentry only speaks truth; the other only lies.

You ask: 'Which door leads to sanctuary?'
Sapphire Sentry: 'My amber-eyed brother will tell you that the Gilded Arch is safe.'
Amber Sentry: 'I speak the truth, and the Silver Arch leads to peace.'

phrases.hard: step boldly through the arch of silver mist

choices.outcomeText: Correct deduction! The silver mist parts into a tranquil treasure vault (+1 Relic, Heal +15 HP)!

phrases.hard: step boldly through the arch of gilded light

choices.outcomeText: Trap! The gilded arch slams shut, spraying caustic acid (-14 HP) and cursing your satchel with Haunted Vellum!

phrases.hard: utter a recursive paradox to freeze both sentries

choices.outcomeText: Both statues short-circuit with stone grinding noises! You loot +60 Gold from their bases and slip away.

title: The Sphinx of the Silent Vowel
narrative: A winged stone sphinx blocks the ancient scriptorium. Carved across her pedestal is an ancient riddle:\n\n'I am never heard when spoken, yet I make the cap a cape, the pan a pane, and the bit a bite. Pronounce my name, traveler, and the treasury shall unlock. Proclaim falsehood, and my granite claws shall feast.'

phrases.hard: proclaim the sacred silent letter e

choices.outcomeText: The Sphinx purrs in satisfaction. 'Wisdom graces your tongue.' The scriptorium unlocks (+1 Rare Card, +55 Gold)!

phrases.hard: proclaim the vowel letter i

choices.outcomeText: The Sphinx roars! 'Falsehood!' Granite claws rake across your chest (-13 HP) before the beast retreats into shadow.

phrases.hard: maintain absolute silence and bow your head

choices.outcomeText: The Sphinx glares, then swats you aside disdainfully (-5 HP). You slip past with no treasure.

title: The Three Alchemical Flasks
narrative:
In an apothecary laboratory, three crystal flasks rest upon a brass shelf labeled Amber, Violet, and Cerulean. An open laboratory ledger notes:
1. 'The healing draught is never placed on the far right.'
2. 'The flask adjacent to the deadly poison glows with violet light.'
3. 'The elixir of wealth is placed directly to the left of the healing draught.'

phrases.hard: drink the glowing amber elixir of wealth

choices.outcomeText: Liquid gold warms your throat! You deduce correctly and gain +125 Gold!

phrases.hard: drink the restorative violet healing draught

choices.outcomeText: Rejuvenating ambrosia soothes your wounds and expands your vigor (+20 HP, +5 Max HP)!

phrases.hard: recklessly drink from the cerulean flask

choices.outcomeText: Deadly poison burns like liquid fire! You violently choke (-16 HP, lose -25 Gold)!

phrases.hard: snatch all three flasks from the shelf and sprint

choices.outcomeText: Greed overwhelms you! The vials violently shatter against each other in your satchel (-10 HP, lose 1 random card, lose 30 Gold)!

title: The Palindrome Vault Door
narrative: A circular vault door of interlocking letter tumblers is sealed tight. An inscription on the arch reads:\n\n'Enter from the dawn or enter from the dusk, my form remains untouched in the dark. Speak the key whose three words reflect themselves across the mirror of time, or the crushing gears shall grind your bones.'

phrases.hard: turn tumblers to level noon radar

choices.outcomeText: The letter tumblers align in perfect bilateral symmetry! The vault pops open (+1 Relic, Upgrade a Card)!

phrases.hard: turn tumblers to royal golden scepter

choices.outcomeText: Asymmetrical imperial words jam the tumblers! Heavy iron pistons crush down on you (-14 HP)!

phrases.hard: turn tumblers to forward always onward

choices.outcomeText: Forward words fail to reflect! The vault alarm detonates (-11 HP, -30 Gold)!

title: The Weighing of the Sins
narrative:
A blindfolded magistrate sits before a balance scale holding three sealed parchment scrolls: Pride, Greed, and Wrath.

He speaks: 'Two scrolls are written in ordinary ink of equal weight. One scroll is inscribed in cursed lead-ink, heavy with corruption. Choose an innocent scroll, and you shall receive its blessing. Choose the leaden scroll, and its curse shall bind to your hand.'

He allows you to test the balance once:
'When Pride and Greed were placed upon the balance, Greed sank down like lead.'

phrases.hard: take the innocent sealed scroll of pride

choices.outcomeText: Pure parchment dissolves into radiant wisdom (+45 Gold, Upgrade a Card)!

phrases.hard: take the innocent sealed scroll of wrath

choices.outcomeText: Righteous fury bolsters your resolve (+1 Rare Card, +5 Max HP)!

phrases.hard: take the heavy sealed scroll of greed

choices.outcomeText: The heavy lead scroll bursts into tarry black smoke (-10 HP) and binds a Royal Censor Writ to your hand!
